title: LUMEN
description: Brand strategy and visual concept for LUMEN.

title: SHADE
description: Seen by none. Controlled by you. Brand strategy and visual concept for a high-security, zero-knowledge digital communication tool designed for high-risk individuals like journalists, executives, and activists.

title: Mutant Font
description: Mutant Font is a web-font designed to protect the privacy of those who have something to say on the internet. This project received international acclaim, including a Cannes Lions award. It explores the intersection of typography and digital privacy.

title: RBS TV
description: RBS TV is a Southern Brazilian television network owned by RBS GROUP. This project involved a complete rebranding for one of the oldest Rede Globo affiliates, modernizing its visual identity while respecting its heritage.

title: Rede Massa TV
description: Logotype and branding for the SBT TV affiliate network in Paraná. The project established a cohesive visual system across multiple stations, ensuring brand consistency and recognition.

title: Ludus Alliance
description: Comprehensive visual identity and digital product design for a martial arts technology company. The work included UI/UX design for their platform, social media strategy, and marketing materials.

title: Orit Hasson
description: Website design for Orit Hasson, an Israeli contemporary artist. Something simple and modern.
